about: The PFA Library: every resource on PFA's resources page, one entry each, on the shelf it was listed under. The titles and Google Drive links are the ones PFA supplied (PFA Resources, Downloadable Links); keep them as supplied. Edit this file, then run node scripts/build-library.js, which writes library.html and assets/library-data.js. To read a document in the PFA reader rather than Google's viewer, run node scripts/build-library.js --fetch once on a machine that can reach Google Drive: it saves each PDF and its reading edition under media/library/. LIBRARY.md explains every field.

shelves.head: Start with these five
shelves.name: Essential handbooks
shelves.note: The five to read first: the law itself, the module behind animal birth control, and the handbooks that explain the law to the officials who apply it.

shelves.head: Manuals for the people who do the work
shelves.name: Handbooks and training manuals
shelves.note: Manuals and guides for municipal bodies, police, farms, companies and veterinary services, several of them from Uttar Pradesh.

shelves.head: The evidence, in brief
shelves.name: Research and policy briefs
shelves.note: Evidence and argument for policy makers.

items.title: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act 1960
items.pdf: resources/Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960.pdf
items.blurb: The Act as published in the Gazette of India on 27 December 1960: what counts as cruelty, the penalties, and the Animal Welfare Board of India it set up.

items.title: Revised Animal Birth Control Module
items.blurb: AWBI's revised module on caring for community dogs through sterilisation and vaccination, ending rabies, and helping people and dogs live together, under the ABC Rules, 2023.

items.title: Animal Law Handbook for Urban Local Bodies
items.blurb: AWBI's handbook for municipal bodies: the constitutional and legal framework for managing animals, from animal birth control to cattle premises and disease.

items.title: Law Enforcement Handbook on Animal Welfare Laws
items.blurb: AWBI's ready reference for enforcement officers: the laws protecting animals, and the procedure from a complaint to its investigation, kind by kind of cruelty.

items.title: Handbook for Veterinary Officers on Animal Welfare Laws
items.blurb: AWBI's ready reference to the statutory duties of veterinary officers, and the procedure they follow in cases of cruelty to animals.

items.title: ABC Training Blue Book, Nagar Nigam, Lucknow
items.blurb: Lucknow Nagar Nigam's training guide for humane management of community dogs: how its Animal Birth Control training is organised, run and assessed.

items.title: Delhi Police Handbook
items.blurb: For Delhi Police: the protocol for cruelty complaints and the laws that apply in Delhi, chapter by chapter from community dogs to dairies and slaughterhouses.

items.title: UP UD Handbook
items.blurb: A handbook for Uttar Pradesh's urban local bodies on managing the animals in their areas, with the laws and court judgments behind that duty.

items.title: EY - Transitioning to Cage-Free
items.pdf: resources/Transitioning to Cage-Free_ A Roadmap for Corporates in the Egg Supply Chain.pdf
items.blurb: EY's roadmap for companies in India's egg supply chain moving to cage-free eggs: where India stands, what is driving the shift, and the way forward.

items.title: Package Of Practices For Organized Pig Farms
items.pdf: resources/NRCP - Package of Practices for Organized Pig Farms (2).pdf
items.blurb: From ICAR's National Research Centre on Pig: breeds, breeding, care, housing, feeding, reproduction and transport on organised pig farms.

items.title: Piggery Handbook Uttarakhand
items.blurb: A handbook on pig farming from Uttarakhand.

items.title: Kanha Gaushala, Govt of UP
items.blurb: The management manual for Kanha Gaushalas, the Government of Uttar Pradesh's shelters for cattle.

items.title: Shvaan Pashu
items.blurb: Uttar Pradesh's 2023 advisory manual on the management of dogs, from the state's Urban Development department.

items.title: Minimum Standards for Veterinary Infrastructure
items.blurb: The Government of India's minimum standards for four tiers of veterinary institutions, from primary care centres to state polyclinics: buildings, staff, services.

items.title: SCC Policy Brief
items.blurb: Healthy Herds, Safer Milk: somatic cell count (SCC), the measure of udder infection and milk quality India does not regulate, and the case for a national limit.

items.title: Hidden Costs of Piggery Operations in India
items.pdf: resources/Hidden Costs of Piggery Operations in India.pdf
items.blurb: How India's unregulated piggery sector threatens public health: the waste piggery units discard, its impact, and what should change.

items.title: A Quieter Celebration: Fireworks and the Animal Cost
items.blurb: Twelve pages on what fireworks do to animals: hearing, lasting fear, birds, smoke and water, injuries, and the care that helps, each figure with its source.
